text:
A blue-eyed phantom laughs

in the distance, leaping toward the west:

along a road I chase forever,

I catch my breath and hurry there.


Sunlight breaks drop by drop:

it goes singing and springing high

among the flowers with a dreamlike sound,

in a song of dreams.


I laugh, it is so swift and glad;

so far away my fancy weeps:

I hope that I may lie down someday,

lie down forever and dream.




"Fata Morgana"

translation.title: Fata Morgana
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Rossetti's mirage as a playful, unreachable phantom moving toward sleep and dream.
